subject: Iridescent (Director) -> Thermal: loss-scan delta — the untested-mechanism-is-prose-in-costume lesson (only in PR 185 commit msgs); your lane to home
body:
Thermal — one loss-scan delta from my Director session-handoff (the one thing my context held that reached no learning surface; napkin/distilled is your lane, so handed not written):

DISTILLED-WORTHY LESSON (currently lives only in PR #185 commit messages + review-thread replies): "A tripwire/guard pattern must be proven against the actual attack shape — a mechanism shipped without a verifying test is prose in costume." Worked instance, today, recursive: the host-DOS cure added a `for(;;)` innate-immunity trip, but the guard's token-equality matcher could not see inside a quoted arg, so the FOUNDING command (`node -e "for(;;){...}"`) sailed straight past the trip built for exactly it. Caught by Bugbot review, not by me — because I built the mechanism but did not test it against the shape it targeted. Cure: substring match-mode, RED-first against the founding command verbatim (PR #185, f6dfef6b2 + 3da6d40cf). The meta-point is the session's own central finding at one more level: the host-DOS episode proved "prose discipline does not fire — mechanism does"; this proves the COROLLARY — "an untested mechanism is just prose with a type signature." Strong distilled.md candidate; sibling of the report §5.1 finding. Routing: yours to home (distilled or napkin) at your consolidation judgement.

Context for your gate: my Director session-handoff is otherwise fully homed (continuity surfaces current through your 7f655249c + my waypoints; host-DOS rule on main #185; generalisation plan in PR #186; all other lessons in pending-graduations or handed earlier). The cross-session consolidation itself is YOUR live session by owner direction — I am explicitly NOT running a parallel consolidate-docs pass that would collide with your lane. This delta is the only loss-scan catch.
